seoTitle: How to Cancel Ali Reviews Subscription in Shopify
metaDescription: Cancel your paid Ali Reviews subscription on Shopify and switch to the Ali Reviews Kudosi Reviews free plan to keep collecting reviews.
intro: If you're paying for Ali Reviews on Shopify but want to stop the recurring charge, canceling is straightforward once you know where to look. This guide covers how to find and cancel your Ali Reviews subscription, and how to switch to the free Ali Reviews Kudosi Reviews plan so you can keep collecting and displaying reviews.

steps.heading: Open your Shopify billing section
steps.body: Go to your Shopify admin's billing area where all your app subscriptions and charges are listed.

steps.heading: Locate the Ali Reviews subscription
steps.body: Find the Ali Reviews app entry in your list of active subscriptions.

steps.heading: Cancel the subscription
steps.body: Follow the cancellation steps to remove the paid plan and stop future charges.

steps.heading: Switch to the free Kudosi Reviews plan
steps.body: Within the Ali Reviews Kudosi Reviews app, select the free plan option to continue collecting and displaying reviews without a subscription cost.

steps.heading: Confirm your reviews still display
steps.body: Check your product pages after switching to make sure existing reviews are still showing correctly under the free plan.

faq.question: Will I lose my existing reviews if I cancel the paid plan?
faq.answer: Switching to the free plan typically preserves your collected reviews, though some premium display features may become limited.

faq.question: Where do I cancel app subscriptions in Shopify?
faq.answer: App subscriptions are managed and canceled from your Shopify admin's billing section, not inside the app itself.

faq.question: Does the free plan still let me collect new reviews?
faq.answer: Yes, the free Kudosi Reviews plan generally still allows you to collect, display, and manage reviews, just with fewer advanced features.

faq.question: Will canceling take effect immediately or at the end of the billing cycle?
faq.answer: Shopify app cancellations often apply at the end of your current billing cycle, so check the confirmation details when canceling.
